cases.question: hey can u tell me abt cst tuition
cases.standalone_question: How much is the tuition for the Computer Systems Technology (CST) program at BCIT?
cases.answer_excerpt:
Full-time tuition for the Computer Systems Technology (CST) program varies depending on your student status (domestic or international) and the specific academic year, but you can estimate your total program and term fees using the BCIT Tuition Estimator tool. 

Key tuition and cost details include:
- **Commitment Fee:** Once admitted, domestic students must pay a $500 commitment fee to secure their seat (which is applied toward tuition), while international students must pay a $6,000 commitment fee.
- **Payment Deadlines:** First-term tuition is due 60 days before the program starts. Returning and continuing students must pay in full within 10 business days of classes starting or have an approved fee deferral.
- **Additional Costs:** Books are estimated to cost $500 to $800 per term. Students must also have their own Windows-compatible laptop, which generally ranges from $1,000 to $2,000. 

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/programs/computer-systems-technology-diploma-full-time-5500dipma/
- https://www.bcit.ca/admission/tuition-fees/full-time-studies/
- https://www.bcit.ca/international-students/programs/tuition-fees/

cases.question: which course can I learn how to use terraform?
cases.standalone_question: Which BCIT course teaches how to use Terraform?
cases.answer_excerpt:
You can learn how to use Terraform in several BCIT courses, including COMP 4964 (DevOps Engineering) and ACIT 4640.

* **COMP 4964 (DevOps Engineering):** Covers Terraform and Ansible in its curriculum during the November/December schedule, alongside other DevOps tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS services.
* **ACIT 4640:** Dedicated topics include an introduction to Terraform (HCL syntax and commands), Terraform modules, variables, and using Terraform to deploy images created with Packer.

Sources:
- https://www.bcit.ca/outlines/20253043982/
